text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a list of features described as user stories. Every day, team members hold short meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to test their work regularly, receive feedback, and improve the product step by step. As a result, Agile helps teams respond quickly to changes and deliver value to customers faster.
